body:
Track 1 follow-up to `selfrep-repair`: derives the repair spare-cost share `c` from the closure of the Prusa Mendel's wear parts (assumed lives) instead of treating it as free. Result: the printer alone makes none of the wear parts, so in-house spares barely move the fleet (c 0.0213 vs 0.0209); a printed-bushing swap only helps if it lasts. Stylised, all inputs assumed. 7 tests; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
